description: Gosset gives biopharma business-development, strategy and investment teams a curated database of drugs, clinical trials, companies, deals, news and regulatory events. In ChatGPT you can search drug pipelines by target, disease, modality or developer; find and compare clinical trials; look up licensing and M&A deals; estimate a trial's probability of advancing to its next phase and its remaining time to completion; and commission longer research reports such as competitive landscapes, standard-of-care summaries and asset evaluations, which you can list and fetch later. Gosset is an industry research tool, not a source of medical advice.
